summary: Porsche Auto Funding LLC filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $911 million in asset-backed notes by Porsche Innovative Lease Owner Trust 2026-1, its issuing entity, under an existing shelf registration. The filing describes standard securitization agreements (SUBI supplement, sale agreement, trust agreement, transfer agreement) executed on the closing date, June 12, 2026. There is no price per share, premium, or board recommendation—this is a routine ABS offering, not a corporate change-of-control or restructuring event. No special-situation action such as acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign is present. The filing is a typical current report for entering into material definitive agreements for a securitization.
